summary.zh: 接入 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱，读信、找信、起草与发送
summary.en: Read, search, draft and send from your IMAP/SMTP mailbox

description.zh:
用授权码或应用专用密码接入 QQ、163、126、腾讯企业邮、阿里云邮箱、Gmail、iCloud、Fastmail、Yahoo、Zoho 与自定义 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱。
插件提供邮件列表、会话阅读、写信（含附件）、账户管理、后台定时同步与新邮件通知；HTML 正文按原排版渲染，支持表格、内嵌样式与图片，发件人显示头像；聊天里的邮件卡片可以直接打开线程 sheet，Agent 可以搜索、阅读、归档、起草，并在你明确要求时直接发送。
description.en:
Connect QQ, 163, 126, Tencent Exmail, Alibaba Mail, Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Yahoo, Zoho or any custom IMAP/SMTP mailbox with an authorization code or app password.
The plugin provides a message list, conversation reading, composing with attachments, account management, background sync and notifications; HTML bodies keep their original layout with tables, inline styles and images, and senders show avatars; mail cards in chat open the thread sheet in place, and the agent can search, read, archive, draft and send directly when you ask.
